findings.title: Production worker-response adapter and public decision surface are missing
findings.evidence: worker_port.py defines only WorkerRolePort and verified_worker_response; the actual adapter exists only in tests/workflow/live_workflow_probe.py and reads decision/response_id from the scripted provider's private responses dictionary. omp_bridge/g3/bridge.ts assistant_message_end publishes only responseMarkerMatched, so a production consumer cannot obtain the worker decision and exact response identity from the public G3 surface.
findings.impact: P-C-AC-03 and P-C-AC-05 runtime currently pass through a test-only private oracle; the public event is not causally bound to the worker decision supplied to TaskWorkflow.
